note: What a server sends to make a unit play an animation. The header names the unit.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: unused0
bits.note: No effect is recorded; a server sends zero.

bits.name: bit1
bits.note: Changes how the animation plays; what it changes is not recorded.

bits.name: unused2
bits.note: No effect is recorded; a server sends zero.

bits.name: bit3
bits.note: Changes how the animation plays; what it changes is not recorded.

bits.name: bit4
bits.note: Changes how the animation plays; what it changes is not recorded.

bits.name: bit5
bits.note: Changes how the animation plays; what it changes is not recorded.

bits.name: bit6
bits.note: Locks the unit's animation, where one of the client's own settings is on.

bits.name: unused7
bits.note: No effect is recorded; a server sends zero.

bits.name: bit8
bits.note: Changes how the animation plays; what it changes is not recorded.

bits.name: bit9
bits.note: Changes how the animation plays; what it changes is not recorded.

bits.name: unusedHigh
bits.note: No effect is recorded; a server sends zero.

fields.note: How the animation plays. How these bits answer to the 4.17 ones is not recorded.

fields.name: scaleTime
fields.note: Where above zero, how many seconds the animation is stretched or squeezed to span; otherwise it plays at normal speed.

fields.name: animation
fields.note: The animation's name, ended by a zero byte. Nothing plays for a name the unit does not have.

revisions.note: No start point or speed is carried: the animation starts from its beginning at normal speed. A client ignores the message while the unit's animation is frozen.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: locked
bits.note: Set where no other animation can fade this one out.

bits.name: lockedFromIdle
bits.note: Set where idle animations cannot fade it out. It has no effect where locked is set.

bits.name: noBlend
bits.note: Set to switch to it at once rather than blend in.

bits.name: loop
bits.note: Set to loop it.

bits.name: keepEmotes
bits.note: Set to let an emote playing go on; clear stops it.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.note: How the animation plays.

fields.name: scaleTime
fields.note: A scale on how long it plays. A client ignores it.

fields.name: startProgress
fields.note: How far into the animation it starts. A client ignores it.

fields.name: animation
fields.note: The animation's name, ended by a zero byte, the two taking at most 64 bytes. Nothing plays for a name the unit does not have.

revisions.note: A client ignores scaleTime and startProgress, and plays at normal speed from the start. A unit holding a locked animation ignores the message. An animated building plays at normal speed, and keepEmotes has no effect on it.
